We did the 8 day Umling-La bike trip with Mototour Ladakh and it was fantastic from start to finish. We have been on a few organized bike trips previously and I will have to say this is one of the best if not thr best of them all. Ladakh is no doubt beautiful but you can't enjoy it to the fullest unless the trip is well organized and this is where Mototour Ladakh scores 15 out of 10. Tashi was our Marshal and he led the group magnificently. He used to stop at every junction where people are bound to get lost or diverted and make sure everyone made it through safely. Skalzang acho brought up the rear and no matter how slow the last rider was, he made sure the back up vehicle was behind the last rider making sure that there were no issues. Naushad was the mechanic for the trip and he used to promptly attend to any issues we had with the bikes and occasionally became a back up bike driver too. The entire team made sure that everyone was comfortable - doing small things like pushing bikes, zipping up the jackets, tightening helmets and on one occasion, during a mini sand storm, asking us to leave all 15 bikes at the fuel station and take shelter in the nearby Dhaba and they themselves filled up all 15 bikes with fuel. You dont get that kind of service often. Even the call to prepone the trip to Umling La proved to be very practical and in hindsight a good desicion. We drove RE Himalayan 411cc bikes and the bikes were well maintained. Every morning Naushad used to go over all the bikes checking brakes, clutch and lubricating the chain. And not to forget, Tanjul was the point of contact during the initial enquiries. She is very knowledgeable and answered all our queries patiently and with clarity. Overall, a very pleasant experience and would definitely recommend to anyone. .

Thank you so much for your detailed and wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear you had such a fantastic experience with us. Your kind words about our team and organization truly mean a lot, and it’s great to know that you enjoyed every aspect of your Umling-La bike trip. We’re glad we could make your Ladakh adventure safe, comfortable, and memorable. Thank you for the recommendation—hope to see you again for more adventures!
